title: RoboRSI: Stable, efficient, and reusable robot self-evolution in complex real-world environments
title_zh: RoboRSI: 基于 Top-Down 技能精炼的机器人自我进化系统

paragraphs.en: Equal contribution. † Corresponding authors.
paragraphs.zh: 同等贡献。† 通讯作者。

paragraphs.en: A generalist robot in complex real-world environments should not only perform diverse tasks but also improve through experience, turning what it learns during execution into capabilities that later tasks can reuse. Robot agents that act through code can already repair programs from execution feedback, yet it remains a central challenge to organize this experience around the task structure that gives it meaning, so that each repair is attributed to the responsible capability, supported by execution evidence, and validated before it is reused. We introduce RoboRSI, a robot self-improvement system built on Top-Down Skill Refinement (TSR). TSR decomposes tasks into compound, atomic, and base skills with scoped responsibilities and explicit input–output contracts, attributes each execution outcome to the responsible branch, and confines revision to that branch. Building upon this structure, a Manager, Planner, Engineer, and Reviewer coordinate planning, execution, diagnosis, and the validated release of new skills, while people steer the process through objectives and corrections; stable skill sequences are further consolidated into reusable compound skills. On a mobile manipulator, RoboRSI develops multi-object household cleanup over 104 rounds. In simulation, it achieves the highest success rate on LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, LIBERO-Plus, and RoboTwin, exceeding the strongest baseline by 2.7 to 11.0 percentage points. Project page: https://lab.noematrix.ai/blog/2-roborsi-research-preview/ Code: https://github.com/nssmd/RoboRSI
paragraphs.zh: 在复杂的现实环境中，通用型机器人不仅应能执行多样化任务，还应通过经验实现自我提升，将执行过程中所学到的内容转化为后续任务可重复使用的能力。 通过代码运行的机器人智能体已经能够根据执行反馈修复程序，但如何将这种经验围绕赋予其意义的任务结构进行组织，仍然是一个核心挑战——这样每次修复都能被归因于相应的能力，并由执行证据支持，在重复使用前完成验证。 我们提出了 RoboRSI，一个基于“自上而下技能精炼”（TSR）的机器人自我提升系统。 TSR 将任务分解为具有明确责任范围和清晰输入-输出契约的复合技能、原子技能和基础技能，将每次执行结果归因于相应的分支，并将修改限制在该分支内。 基于这一结构，管理器、规划器、工程师和评审员协同完成规划、执行、诊断以及新技能的验证发布，同时人类通过设定目标和提出修正来引导整个过程；稳定的技能序列将进一步整合为可重复使用的复合技能。 在一台移动机械臂上，RoboRSI 经过 104 轮训练，实现了多目标家庭环境清洁任务。 在模拟环境中，它在 LIBERO、LIBERO-PRO、LIBERO-Plus 和 RoboTwin 测试集上取得了最高的成功率，比最强基线模型高出 2.7 至 11.0 个百分点。 项目页面：https://lab.noematrix.ai/blog/2-roborsi-research-preview/ 代码：https://github.com/nssmd/RoboRSI

paragraphs.en: The vision of generalist robotics is to develop robots that perform a broad range of tasks reliably in complex real-world environments, where objects, layouts, and instructions keep changing, while improving through experience. This shifts the goal of robot agents from episode-level task completion toward sustained capability accumulation: failed grasps, stale object locations, and recovery situations are valuable only if the robot can identify the capability involved, refine it using execution evidence, and make the resulting behavior available to later tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 通用型机器人的愿景是开发能够在复杂真实环境中可靠执行广泛任务的机器人，这些环境中的物体、布局和指令会持续变化，同时机器人还能通过经验不断改进。 这将机器人智能体的目标从单轮任务完成转向持续的能力积累：失败的抓取、过时的物体位置以及恢复情境只有在机器人能够识别其中涉及的能力、利用执行证据对其进行优化，并将由此产生的行为用于后续任务时才有价值。

paragraphs.en: A promising route lets foundation models act through code. Code as Policies ( Liang et al., 2023 ) composes perception and control primitives into executable robot programs, and CaP-X ( Fu et al., 2026 ) studies how abstraction, grounding, and interaction shape such programs. Subsequent work closes the loop with execution feedback: ETA/OpenETA ( Chen et al., 2026b ) interleaves planning and tool execution with fresh observations, ASPIRE ( Lu et al., 2026 ) adds repaired programs to a growing skill library, and ENPIRE ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) carries this loop into physical experimentation. Execution feedback thus shifts from a signal for correcting a single attempt to a resource for building capabilities that persist across tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 一条有前景的路径是让基础模型通过代码来执行操作。 “代码即策略”（Liang 等人，2023）将感知与控制的基本单元组合成可执行的机器人程序，而 CaP-X（Fu 等人，2026）则研究了抽象、接地和交互如何塑造这类程序。 后续研究通过执行反馈实现了闭环：ETA/OpenETA（Chen 等人，2026b）将规划与工具执行同新的观察结果交替进行；ASPIRE（Lu 等人，2026）将修复后的程序加入不断扩展的技能库；ENPIRE（Xiao 等人，2026）则将此循环延伸至物理实验。 因此，执行反馈不再仅仅是用于纠正单次尝试的信号，而是成为构建跨任务持久能力的资源。

paragraphs.en: Execution experience, however, becomes a reusable capability only when it is organized around the task structure that gives it meaning. A repair must remain connected to the objective that motivated it, belong to the capability responsible for the observed behavior, and be validated before it is reused. Without such structure, repeated attempts fill the context with complete trajectories, local fixes drift from the overall objective, and people are drawn back into resetting environments, reading logs, and deciding where each fix belongs.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，执行经验只有在围绕赋予其意义的任务结构进行组织时，才能成为可重复使用的能力。 修复必须与引发该修复的目标保持关联，属于负责所观察行为的智能体能力，并在被重新使用之前得到验证。 如果没有这样的结构，反复尝试会将上下文填满完整的轨迹，局部修复会偏离总体目标，而人们则会被迫重新进入环境重置、阅读日志，并决定每个修复应归属何处。

paragraphs.en: Our observation is that this structure must serve both the people directing the robot and the agents implementing its behavior, which calls for two complementary abstractions. Human-friendly steering lets people express objectives, domain knowledge, constraints, and safety judgments at the level of the service they need. Agent-friendly structure gives agents task-relevant context, explicit interfaces, and bounded responsibilities for execution and revision.
paragraphs.zh: 我们的观察是，这种结构必须同时服务于指导机器人的人类以及执行其行为的智能体，因此需要两种互补的抽象层次。 人性化操控使人们能够在所需服务的层面上表达目标、领域知识、约束条件和安全判断。 面向智能体的结构则为智能体提供与任务相关的上下文、明确的接口，以及执行和修订方面的有限责任。

paragraphs.en: Based on this observation, we introduce RoboRSI , a multi-agent system for robot self-improvement organized by Top-Down Skill Refinement (TSR) . TSR decomposes each task into compound, atomic, and base skills with scoped responsibilities and explicit input–output contracts, attributes each execution outcome to the responsible branch, and confines the revision to that branch: an inadequate decomposition revises the task structure, an unreliable composition the corresponding compound skill, and a failed operation the responsible atomic or base skill. A Manager, Planner, Engineer, and Reviewer carry out planning, execution, diagnosis, and validated release, and stable skill sequences are consolidated into compound skills that later executions select and monitor instead of reconstructing every tool decision.

RoboRSI achieves the highest success rate on all four benchmarks, exceeding the strongest baseline by 5.3 points on LIBERO, 11.0 on LIBERO-PRO, 5.7 on LIBERO-Plus, and 2.7 on RoboTwin.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在一个移动机械臂上评估了 RoboRSI，该机械臂在场景变化中执行多物体家庭清洁任务，其技能经过 104 轮训练逐步发展；同时，我们还在模拟环境中将其与 LIBERO、LIBERO-PRO 和 RoboTwin 上的机器人-智能体基线模型进行了对比，并将冻结的能力迁移到了 LIBERO-Plus。 RoboRSI 在全部四个基准测试中均取得了最高的成功率，分别比最强的基线模型高出 5.3 分（LIBERO）、11.0 分（LIBERO-PRO）、5.7 分（LIBERO-Plus）和 2.7 分（RoboTwin）。

paragraphs.en: Complementary abstractions for robot self-improvement: we identify that execution experience becomes reusable only when it is tied to the task structure that gives it meaning, and that this structure must serve both human-friendly steering and agent-friendly structure.
paragraphs.zh: 机器人自我改进的互补抽象：我们发现，只有当执行经验与其赋予其意义的任务结构相绑定时，它才能被重复利用；而这种结构必须同时服务于人类友好的引导和智能体友好的架构。

paragraphs.en: RoboRSI Framework: a system that realizes these abstractions through Top-Down Skill Refinement, which verifies each atomic task’s postcondition before completion and revises each failure at its earliest failing node, and a multi-agent execution–refinement loop that validates and releases skills across tasks.
paragraphs.zh: RoboRSI 框架：一个通过“自上而下技能精炼”实现这些抽象概念的系统。该系统在每项原子任务完成前验证其后置条件，并在最早出现的失败节点处修正每次失败；同时，它还包含一个多智能体执行-精炼循环，用于跨任务验证和释放技能。

paragraphs.en: Real-world and simulated evaluation: skill development on a mobile manipulator over 104 rounds, the highest success on four simulation benchmarks, and ablations of role separation, skill refinement, and compound skills.
paragraphs.zh: 真实世界与模拟评估：移动机械臂在 104 轮中的技能发展，在四个模拟基准测试中取得最高成功率，以及对角色分离、技能优化和组合技能的消融研究。

paragraphs.en: Code as Policies ( Liang et al., 2023 ) showed that language models can write robot programs that compose perception and control APIs, turning high-level instructions into executable behavior. Follow-up work examines what these programs should be built from: CaP-X ( Fu et al., 2026 ) studies the abstraction level of primitives, perceptual grounding, and interaction, and GRACE ( Sun et al., 2025 ) encodes affordances and geometry as executable concepts. ASPIRE ( Lu et al., 2026 ) goes further by repairing failed programs and keeping the repaired skills in a growing library. Once programs are kept and reused, however, a repair to one skill can affect every task that calls it, and deciding where a repair belongs becomes as important as writing it. RoboRSI addresses this through TSR, which gives each capability an interface and a declared responsibility, so that a repair is made at the responsible branch and composes with the skills around it.

paragraphs.en: RSI studies how an agent’s experience improves its later behavior. Language agents first did so through verbal feedback: Reflexion stores reflections on failed attempts, and Self-Refine iteratively critiques and revises its own outputs ( Shinn et al., 2023 ; Madaan et al., 2023 ) . Voyager moved from text to executable skills, accumulating a code library through open-ended interaction ( Wang et al., 2024 ) . Multimodal agents extend this idea with skills acquired from external resources, execution feedback, and reusable procedures, as in RESOURCE2SKILL, EvoSkill-GUI, and OmniHarness ( Fan et al., 2026 ; Chen et al., 2026a ; Xu et al., 2026 ) . Robot-specific work detects and explains failures during execution: ProgPrompt adds assertions to generated programs ( Singh et al., 2023 ) , REFLECT summarizes robot experience to explain and correct failures ( Liu et al., 2023b ) , DoReMi and Code-as-Monitor monitor language- or code-specified constraints to trigger recovery ( Guo et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2025 ) , and AHA trains a vision-language model to detect and reason about manipulation failures ( Duan et al., 2025 ) . These methods detect a failure within an episode; RoboRSI additionally decides which skill should change and validates the change before later tasks reuse it. In embodied settings, EmbodiSkill diagnoses errors at the level of individual skills ( Ju et al., 2026 ) , and ENPIRE couples physical evaluation with coding-agent refinement of policies ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) . Physical execution adds a difficulty that software environments largely avoid: a failure may originate several steps before it is observed, and a change to a shared skill affects tasks that were not part of the failed run. RoboRSI therefore attributes each failure to its earliest failing node, validates revisions against the recent history of the affected tasks, and reuses capabilities through explicit skill interfaces.

paragraphs.en: Large language models first entered robotics as planners. Early work grounded generated plans in admissible actions ( Huang et al., 2022a ) , and Inner Monologue fed environment feedback back into planning ( Huang et al., 2022b ) . Advances in multimodal understanding ( Alayrac et al., 2022 ; Liu et al., 2023a ; Gemini Team and others, 2024 ) , embodied grounding ( Driess et al., 2023 ) , and interleaved reasoning and acting ( Yao et al., 2023 ) then allowed models to reason directly over observations, and VoxPoser ( Huang et al., 2023 ) and ReKep ( Huang et al., 2024 ) used generated code to compose 3D value maps and relational keypoint constraints for motion planning. A parallel line trains robot foundation models end to end. Vision–language–action models such as RT-2, OpenVLA, π 0 \pi_{0} , and π 0.5 \pi_{0.5} learn visuomotor control from large robot datasets ( Brohan et al., 2023 ; Kim et al., 2024 ; Black et al., 2025 ; Physical Intelligence et al., 2025 ) ; world-action models such as Zero-WAM add predictive visual dynamics ( Zhou et al., 2026 ) ; and Gemini Robotics and Gemini Robotics-ER 1.5 combine control with embodied reasoning ( Gemini Robotics Team and others, 2025 ) . As general-purpose models have become more capable, recent systems use them directly for robot decisions and actions. Maestro orchestrates perception and control modules ( Shi et al., 2025 ) , ETA/OpenETA closes the loop between planning, execution, and feedback ( Chen et al., 2026b ) , GPT-Policy performs in-context control ( Cheng et al., 2026 ) , two RoboHarness systems adapt through memory ( Huang et al., 2026 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , and UniDomain and UniPlan connect symbolic planning with visual grounding ( Ye et al., 2025 ; Ye et al., 2026 ) . RoboRSI complements these directions at the system level: TSR and multi-agent execution maintain reusable skills, and the trajectories collected during execution can train policies that return as tools in the same hierarchy.
paragraphs.zh: 大型语言模型最初以规划器的身份进入机器人领域。 早期的研究将生成的计划基于可执行的动作（Huang 等人，2022a），而“内心独白”方法则将环境反馈重新输入规划过程（Huang 等人，2022b）。 随后，多模态理解（Alayrac 等人，2022；Liu 等人，2023a；Gemini 团队及其他研究者，2024）、具身化 grounding（Driess 等人，2023），以及推理与行动交替进行（Yao 等人，2023）方面的进展，使模型能够直接基于观察结果进行推理；VoxPoser（Huang 等人，2023）和 ReKep（Huang 等人，2024）则利用生成的代码构建三维价值地图和关系关键点约束，用于运动规划。 另一条并行路线则是将机器人基础模型进行端到端训练。 视觉-语言-动作模型（如 RT-2、OpenVLA、π₀ 和 π₀.₅）通过大型机器人数据集学习视觉-运动控制（Brohan 等人，2023；Kim 等人，2024；Black 等人，2025；Physical Intelligence 等人，2025）；世界-动作模型（如 Zero-WAM）则加入了预测性视觉动态（Zhou 等人，2026）；而 Gemini Robotics 和 Gemini Robotics-ER 1.5 则将控制与具身化推理相结合（Gemini Robotics 团队及其他研究者，2025）。 随着通用模型能力的提升，近期系统开始直接利用这些模型进行机器人决策和行动。 Maestro 负责协调感知与控制模块（Shi 等人，2025）；ETA/OpenETA 实现了规划、执行与反馈之间的闭环（Chen 等人，2026b）；GPT-Policy 实现了上下文内控制（Cheng 等人，2026）；两个 RoboHarness 系统通过记忆实现自适应（Huang 等人，2026；Li 等人，2026）；而 UniDomain 和 UniPlan 则将符号规划与视觉 grounding 相连接（Ye 等人，2025；Ye 等人，2026）。 RoboRSI 在系统层面补充了这些方向：TSR 和多智能体执行机制能够维持可复用的技能，而执行过程中收集的运动轨迹可用于训练策略，使其作为工具返回到同一层级结构中。

paragraphs.en: Consider a coding agent connected directly to robot tools and asked to improve a household cleanup task in a complex real-world home over many runs. The context fills with records of earlier runs; a failure observed late in a sequence is patched where it appears, for example by adding retries to the release step, although it originated in perception or navigation; and because the objective is implicit in the latest prompt, successive edits optimize for the latest scene. People are then drawn back into reading logs and deciding where each fix belongs. RoboRSI removes this burden by making both the intent of the people and the work of the agents explicit.

paragraphs.en: RoboRSI turns repeated robot execution into a growing library of reusable skills, organized around the two abstractions of Section 1 . Human-friendly steering is the channel through which people enter objectives, constraints, domain knowledge, and corrections at the level of the task; each correction is kept as maintained guidance on the responsible skill. Agent-friendly structure is the task–skill hierarchy in which the agents work: every task and skill has an interface, a declared responsibility, and a record of recent executions, so each agent receives only the part of the hierarchy that its current step concerns.
paragraphs.zh: RoboRSI 将重复的机器人执行过程转化为一个不断增长的、可重复使用的技能库，这些技能围绕第 1 节中提出的两种抽象概念进行组织。 面向人类的引导机制是人们输入目标、约束条件、领域知识和修正信息的渠道，这些信息都处于任务层面；每次修正都会被保留为对相应技能的持续指导。 面向智能体的结构是智能体在其中工作的任务–技能层级体系：每个任务和技能都拥有接口、明确的责任划分以及最近执行记录，因此每个智能体只会接收到与其当前步骤相关的层级部分。

sents.en: RoboRSI turns repeated robot execution into a growing library of reusable skills, organized around the two abstractions of Section 1 .

sents.en: Human-friendly steering is the channel through which people enter objectives, constraints, domain knowledge, and corrections at the level of the task; each correction is kept as maintained guidance on the responsible skill.
sents.zh: 面向人类的引导机制是人们输入目标、约束条件、领域知识和修正信息的渠道，这些信息都处于任务层面；每次修正都会被保留为对相应技能的持续指导。

sents.en: Agent-friendly structure is the task–skill hierarchy in which the agents work: every task and skill has an interface, a declared responsibility, and a record of recent executions, so each agent receives only the part of the hierarchy that its current step concerns.
sents.zh: 面向智能体的结构是智能体在其中工作的任务–技能层级体系：每个任务和技能都拥有接口、明确的责任划分以及最近执行记录，因此每个智能体只会接收到与其当前步骤相关的层级部分。

paragraphs.en: The hierarchy contains four kinds of nodes (Figures 2 and 3 ). A task family , such as household cleanup, groups tasks that share goals and constraints. Each task is decomposed into atomic tasks , scoped goals with an observable outcome such as placing an object in a container, each achieved by an atomic skill with a postcondition. Atomic skills call base skills , the perception and control primitives exposed as tools. A stable sequence of skills is consolidated into a compound skill , a parameterized code policy invoked as a single unit. Every skill declares its inputs, outputs, and responsibility, and a skill may be shared by several branches.
paragraphs.zh: 该层级结构包含四种节点（图2和图3）。 一个任务族，例如家庭清洁，将具有共同目标和约束的任务归为一类。 每个任务都被分解为原子任务，即具有可观察结果的限定目标，例如将物体放入容器中，而每个原子任务都通过一个带有后置条件的原子技能完成。 原子技能调用基础技能，即作为工具暴露的感知和控制原语。 稳定的技能序列被整合为一个复合技能，即一个作为单一单元调用的参数化代码策略。 每个技能都会声明其输入、输出和责任，并且一个技能可能被多个分支共享。

paragraphs.en: Coding agents can solve local programming problems yet lose the task objective across repeated edits, misinterpret physical conditions, or tailor a fix too closely to one failed scene. TSR therefore organizes implementation and revision around the skill hierarchy of Section 3.1 : the task family and its atomic tasks preserve the global objective, while atomic, compound, and base skills provide bounded places for implementation, experience, and revision (Figure 3 a); Figure 3 b follows two revisions on the physical robot.
paragraphs.zh: 编码智能体能够解决局部编程问题，但在反复编辑过程中可能会偏离任务目标、误解物理条件，或针对某个失败场景过度定制解决方案。 因此，TSR 围绕第 3.1 节中的技能层级来组织实现与修订：任务族及其原子任务保留了全局目标，而原子技能、复合技能和基础技能则为实现、经验和修订提供了有限的空间（图 3a）；图 3b 展示了物理机器人上的两次修订过程。

paragraphs.en: Three principles connect local revision to reliable execution and reuse. Responsibility and interface trust: each skill reports its outcome through an explicit interface, so callers rely on its postconditions instead of duplicating its checks, and diagnosis follows the call path to the responsible component instead of spreading fixes across callers. Parameterization and history-guided revision: object classes, conditions, target relations, and execution order become parameters, scene geometry comes from current observations, and each change is checked against recent successful uses of the skill. Persistent human knowledge: a human correction becomes a runtime check, a test, or maintained guidance on the responsible skill, so people can concentrate on goals and exploration direction.
paragraphs.zh: 三项原则将局部修订与可靠的执行和重用联系起来。 责任与接口信任：每个技能都通过显式接口报告其结果，因此调用者依赖其后置条件，而不是重复其检查；诊断则沿着调用路径追踪到负责组件，而不是将修复工作分散到各个调用者中。 参数化与历史引导修订：对象类、条件、目标关系和执行顺序成为参数，场景几何信息来自当前观察结果，每次变更都会与技能近期成功使用的情况进行核对。 持久的人类知识：人类的修正会转化为运行时检查、测试或对负责技能的持续指导，从而让人们能够专注于目标和探索方向。

paragraphs.en: Four agents carry out each round within this structure. The Manager decomposes the goal into atomic tasks, identifies the base skills each one needs, maintains skill versions, reviews each proposed revision, may request or author changes to it, and decides whether it is admitted, which branch it may change, and whether it is released. The Planner receives one atomic task, the current observation, and the interfaces of the skills below it, and returns an executable plan. The Engineer executes the plan through the tool interface and implements missing skills. The Reviewer judges from the observations and tool trace whether an atomic task reached its expected outcome and, for a failure, identifies where execution first diverged, and writes a revision patch for the responsible branch that it submits to the Manager. Each agent works from the part of the hierarchy that its step concerns, so its context stays short and every change can be traced to a diagnosis.
paragraphs.zh: 在此结构中，每轮由四个智能体共同执行。 管理器将目标分解为原子任务，确定每个任务所需的基础技能，维护技能版本，审查每一项拟议的修订，可请求或批准对其修改，并决定该任务是否被采纳、允许其更改哪个分支以及是否予以发布。 规划器接收一个原子任务、当前观察结果及其下属技能的接口，并返回一个可执行的计划。 工程师通过工具接口执行计划，并实现缺失的技能。 评审员根据观察结果和工具轨迹判断某个原子任务是否达到了预期结果；若出现失败，则定位执行流程首次偏离之处，并为负责分支编写修订补丁，然后将其提交给管理器。 每个智能体仅处理其当前步骤所涉及的层级部分，因此其上下文保持简短，且任何更改都能追溯至具体的诊断结果。

paragraphs.en: We study household floor cleanup with a WheelSingleArm M1 mobile manipulator. The robot searches for objects, approaches and grasps them, and transports them to designated receptacles. The case study covers 104 physical development runs with 24 hours of cumulative operation. Before each run, the scene is restored to a common base layout, while the objects and receptacles are partially randomized; the navigation map remains fixed. Platform details and the reset procedure are given in Appendix B .
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用 WheelSingleArm M1 移动机械臂研究家庭地面清洁任务。 该机器人会搜索物体、靠近并抓取它们，然后将它们运送到指定的容器中。 这项案例研究涵盖了 104 次物理开发运行，累计运行时间为 24 小时。 每次运行前，场景都会恢复到统一的初始布局，但物体和容器会被部分随机化；导航地图则保持固定不变。 平台细节与重置流程见附录 B。

paragraphs.en: Figure 4 follows ten selected runs from the 104-run development period. In the earliest selected run, the robot placed no objects. Later runs progressed to placing several objects, and some completed their assigned cleanup tasks and returned to the dock. The change was not steady: a later run recorded only one placement after complete runs had already appeared. We counted an object only when on-site personnel observed it enter its designated receptacle. The figure displays at most four placements per run, although the task manifests varied in size.
paragraphs.zh: 图4展示了104次运行开发周期中选取的十次运行结果。 在最早被选中的那次运行中，机器人没有放置任何物体。 后续的运行逐渐发展到放置多个物体，其中一些甚至完成了分配给它们的清理任务并返回了停靠点。 这种变化并不稳定：在一次较晚的运行中，尽管此前已经出现过完整的运行流程，但仅记录了一次物体放置。 只有当现场人员观察到物体进入其指定的容器时，我们才会将其计为一次放置。 该图每次运行最多显示四次物体放置，尽管任务清单的大小各不相同。

paragraphs.en: RoboRSI accumulates skills serially: each episode runs with the current library, and revisions that pass validation are released to the episodes that follow. To our knowledge, no existing robot-agent system accumulates skills in this serial form. ASPIRE ( Lu et al., 2026 ) , the closest self-improving code agent, learns every task in parallel with a dedicated agent that runs a population-based search over candidate programs, admits the resulting skills after the search, and evaluates one generated program per task; ENPIRE ( Xiao et al., 2026 ) refines learned policies and their training code through physical experimentation. Both rely on development loops that differ from a single serial stream, so they cannot be run under the same protocol. We therefore compare with the strongest agents that act through code or tools, CaP-X, Maestro, and OpenETA, with the same backbone.
paragraphs.zh: RoboRSI 以串行方式积累技能：每一轮实验都基于当前的技能库运行，而通过验证的修订版本会被用于后续的实验。 据我们所知，目前没有任何现有的机器人-智能体系统能够以这种串行形式积累技能。 ASPIRE（Lu 等人，2026）是最接近自增强代码智能体的系统，它能与一个专用智能体并行学习所有任务；该专用智能体在候选程序空间中进行基于种群的搜索，接受搜索后产生的技能，并为每个任务评估一个生成的程序；ENPIRE（Xiao 等人，2026）则通过物理实验来优化已学习的策略及其训练代码。 这两种方法都依赖不同于单一串行流程的开发循环，因此无法在相同的协议下运行。 因此，我们将其与通过代码或工具执行操作的、具有相同基础架构的最强智能体 CaP-X、Maestro 和 OpenETA 进行比较。

paragraphs.en: All methods are evaluated under the same conditions: the same backbone, tool interface, per-episode interaction budget, task panels, and simulator verdict. The baselines execute with a fixed set of tools and skills and do not revise or add skills across episodes; RoboRSI differs only in that it can use the outcome of an episode to revise its skills for later episodes. Improving on the tasks at hand is the capability that RoboRSI contributes, so the comparison on LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, and RoboTwin measures what self-improvement adds over strong fixed agents. LIBERO-Plus complements this by evaluating the library with self-improvement disabled on perturbed instances.
paragraphs.zh: 所有方法都在相同条件下进行评估：相同的骨干网络、工具接口、每集交互预算、任务面板以及模拟器判定。 基线方法使用固定的工具和技能集执行，且不会在不同剧集间修改或添加技能；RoboRSI 的不同之处在于，它可以根据某一集的结果来调整后续剧集的技能。 RoboRSI 所贡献的能力正是对当前任务的改进，因此，在 LIBERO、LIBERO-PRO 和 RoboTwin 上的比较旨在衡量自我提升相较于强大的固定智能体所带来的额外价值。 LIBERO-Plus 则通过在对扰动实例中禁用自我提升来评估该工具库，从而对此形成补充。

paragraphs.en: Section 4.5 isolates the components of the system: role separation (36 versus 9 of 50 RoboTwin tasks), TSR against flat revision on the same failure, compound skills over 600 matched episode pairs ( + 7.5 +7.5 points, McNemar p < 10 − 4 p<10^{-4} ), the backbone model, and policies learned from execution data.
paragraphs.zh: 第 4.5 节分析了系统的各个组成部分：角色分离（在 50 个 RoboTwin 任务中，36 项与 9 项相比）、针对相同故障的 TSR 与直接修订的对比、跨越 600 对匹配回合的复合技能（+7.5 +7.5 分，McNemar p < 10^{-4}）、骨干模型，以及从执行数据中学习到的策略。

paragraphs.en: The main comparison comprises 5,974 evaluation episodes: 150 per method on LIBERO and 600 on LIBERO-PRO, each with five initial states per task, 840 perturbation instances per method on LIBERO-Plus, and 150 episodes per baseline and 154 for RoboRSI on RoboTwin. The ablations add 2,770 episodes, and the physical study covers 104 development rounds. In total, RoboRSI is evaluated on 230 tasks across four benchmarks with 1,744 episodes. For reference, the main LIBERO evaluation of OpenETA uses 40 tasks with ten seeds each (400 episodes), and its self-evolution studies use at most ten tasks ( Chen et al., 2026b ) ; ASPIRE evaluates 69 tasks on LIBERO-PRO, Robosuite, and BEHAVIOR-1K ( Lu et al., 2026 ) ; the memory-augmented harness of Li et al. (2026) is evaluated on 25 tasks, and Huang et al. (2026) on LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, and five long-horizon tasks.

paragraphs.en: Self-improvement is part of the evaluated capability: on LIBERO, LIBERO-PRO, and RoboTwin, RoboRSI starts from its initial skill library and improves online on the evaluation tasks, summarizing failures and revising skills as evaluation proceeds, whereas the baselines have no self-improvement mechanism (Section 4.2 ). paragraphs.en: About two thirds of the failures of OpenETA and Maestro on LIBERO-PRO (66% and 64%) and of OpenETA on LIBERO-Plus (66%) are premature completions: the agent declares the task done after a tool reports a release, while the simulator judges it unfinished (Figure 6 a). paragraphs.en: To examine self-iteration without human steering, we let RoboRSI iterate on its own for one day on a 120-task LIBERO catalog and on the 120 LIBERO-PRO tasks. paragraphs.en: We examine the three episodes of Figure 9 , in which RoboRSI succeeds while the baselines fail from the same initial state, and then follow a revised skill as it is reused on tasks it was not developed on (Figure 8 ).

paragraphs.en: On LIBERO-Plus, the task is to place a cream-cheese package in a basket. OpenETA’s combined pick-and-place tool returned that the object had been released at the destination, and the agent declared success at once. CaP-X’s placement also reported a release while its containment check remained unverified. Both episodes failed. RoboRSI, with its frozen source library, received a placement result stating that the gripper had not opened. Rather than ending, it checked whether it still held the package, re-observed the basket from the head and top views, placed the package again, and succeeded.
paragraphs.zh: 在 LIBERO-Plus 中，任务是将一包奶油奶酪放入篮中。 OpenETA 的联合抓取与放置工具返回结果表明，该物体已在目标位置释放，智能体随即宣布成功。 CaP-X 的放置操作也报告了释放状态，但其约束检查仍未通过验证。这两个案例均未成功。 RoboRSI 因其源库被冻结，收到一个放置结果，表明夹爪并未打开。 它并未结束任务，而是检查是否仍持有该包装，从正面和顶部重新观察篮中情况，再次放置包装，并最终成功。

Because the skill is shared through the hierarchy, a repair made in one task becomes available to every branch that calls it.

paragraphs.en: We compare development on the 50 RoboTwin tasks with a single agent and with separate roles (Table 4 ). Separating diagnosis from execution gives every failure an independent review before the next attempt, instead of leaving the executing agent to judge its own result.

paragraphs.en: TSR determines where the system improves. We therefore compare TSR with flat revision on how well each turns an observed failure into a validated, released improvement, rather than on task success. Both conditions start from the same code and memory and receive the same public traces of a failed libero_pick_place execution on libero_goal/8 . They may modify Atomic and Base skills, and use the same Planner, Engineer, Reviewer, and Manager review. A candidate is released only if the Base functional checks pass and the complete Atomic task succeeds on both development seeds. Under TSR, the Reviewer first builds a responsibility tree from the Atomic failure and selects the layers to revise; under flat revision, it proposes a revision directly from the failure.

paragraphs.en: The success gain follows from how errors arise in long tool sequences. Without code, the agent reconstructs the sequence in every episode, and each step is another opportunity to choose the wrong tool, pass an inconsistent argument, or skip a check between steps; over sequences of many steps, these errors accumulate. A compound skill fixes the validated order of calls and the checks between them, so the agent decides only which skill to invoke and with which parameters. The physical Round 25 failure in Section 3.2 shows the same effect: a model-written release sequence dropped steps that the code-produced sequence contained. The cost reductions have the same source, since one skill call replaces several model decisions. Wall time falls less than tokens and model calls because the motion executed in the simulator is unchanged; only the reasoning between motions is removed. The agent still responds to execution feedback and returns to step-by-step reasoning when a compound skill reports a failure.
paragraphs.zh: 成功收益源于长工具序列中错误产生的方式。 没有代码时，智能体在每个回合都会重构该序列，而每一步都是再次选择错误工具、传递不一致参数或跳过步骤间检查的机会；在包含许多步骤的序列中，这些错误会不断累积。 复合技能固定了调用的有效顺序以及步骤间的检查，因此智能体只需决定调用哪个技能及其参数。 第 3.2 节中物理环境下的第 25 轮失败展示了同样的效果：模型编写的发布序列省略了代码生成的序列中包含的步骤。 成本降低源于同一原因，因为一次技能调用取代了多次模型决策。 实际运行时间比令牌和模型调用减少得少，因为在模拟器中执行的动作没有变化；被移除的只是动作之间的推理过程。 当复合技能报告失败时，智能体仍然会响应执行反馈并回归到逐步推理模式。

paragraphs.en: We compare GPT-5.6-SOL, GPT-5.5, and GPT-5.4 across the reasoning roles with the same initial skills, task distribution, and interaction budget (Table 6 ). GPT-5.5 reaches the highest LIBERO-PRO success, 48.6%, and leads on the Object and Goal suites, while GPT-5.6-SOL is best on RoboTwin. The number of model calls hardly differs, with medians of 115 to 124 per LIBERO-PRO episode, so the stronger backbone does not win by reasoning longer. The difference lies in how often an episode runs out of budget: GPT-5.4 exhausts it in 101 episodes and GPT-5.5 in 80, so the stronger backbone reaches a verified outcome within the budget more often. Because the ranking changes between benchmarks while the task structure and skill library stay the same, the choice of backbone interacts with the benchmark rather than favoring one model throughout.

paragraphs.en: Successful RoboRSI executions provide demonstrations for training compact visuomotor policies, which can then be exposed as skills in the hierarchy. We train ACT policies ( Zhao et al., 2023 ) on 10 successful click_bell and 7 successful click_alarmclock executions and compare two action representations with the same data, architecture, and 10,000 training steps. With absolute joint targets, neither task is solved in any evaluated layout. Expressing the joint targets relative to the arm configuration at the start of each action chunk raises success to 4/10 on the bell training layouts, and on the alarm clock to 6/7 on training layouts and 2/3 on collection layouts that did not supply training data (Figure 11 ). With so few demonstrations, an absolute target requires the policy to regress the full arm configuration at every step, and small regression errors move the end effector away from the small contact region that these pressing tasks require. A chunk-relative target encodes only how the arm moves from its current configuration, which the demonstrations constrain far more tightly: on the training observations, the joint-command error falls by 57%, from 0.0086 to 0.0037 rad. Appendix C.3 gives the training details.
paragraphs.zh: 成功的 RoboRSI 执行过程为训练紧凑型视觉运动策略提供了演示，这些策略随后可以作为技能暴露于层级结构中。 我们在 10 次成功的 click_bell 执行和 7 次成功的 click_alarmclock 执行上训练 ACT 策略（Zhao 等人，2023），并使用相同的数据、架构和 10,000 个训练步数比较了两种动作表示。 在使用绝对关节目标的情况下，任何评估的布局中都无法解决这两个任务中的任何一个。 将关节目标相对于每个动作片段开始时的机械臂配置进行表达后，在铃铛训练布局上的成功率提升至 4/10，在闹钟训练布局上提升至 6/7，在未提供训练数据的收集布局上则提升至 2/3（图 11）。 在演示如此有限的情况下，绝对目标要求策略在每个步骤中都对完整的机械臂配置进行回归，而微小的回归误差会使末端执行器偏离这些按压任务所需的小接触区域。 片段相对目标仅编码了机械臂从其当前配置开始如何移动，而演示对此的约束要严格得多：在训练观测数据中，关节指令误差下降了 57%，从 0.0086 rad 降至 0.0037 rad。 附录 C.3 提供了训练细节。

paragraphs.en: RoboRSI combines Top-Down Skill Refinement and multi-agent coordination to organize execution, diagnosis, local revision, and reusable capability, toward stable, efficient, and reusable robot self-evolution in complex real-world environments. Future work will transfer simulation-acquired experience to physical robots and share skills across robots and platforms.
paragraphs.zh: RoboRSI 结合了自上而下的技能精炼与多智能体协作，以组织执行、诊断、局部修正和可重复使用的能力，从而实现机器人复杂真实环境中的稳定、高效且可重复使用的自我进化。 未来的工作将把在模拟中获得的经验迁移到物理机器人上，并在不同机器人和平台之间共享技能。

paragraphs.en: Each skill has a descriptor that declares its arguments, typed return fields, applicability conditions, and a validation harness (simulator task, seeds, arguments, and any setup skill). The return fields report whether the intended effect was verified; for example, a placement skill returns whether the target was reached, the gripper opened, and the release was verified, and it does not open the gripper unless its reach and hold checks pass. An atomic task counts as complete only when its postcondition holds on fresh observations taken after the last action. A candidate revision is staged in an isolated copy of the library and reviewed by the Manager. If it changes a base skill, the harness of that skill runs in the simulator; the complete atomic task is then re-run on its development seeds. Release requires simulator success on at least two declared seeds, restoration of the unmodified source after the trial, and Manager approval with no outstanding changes; a candidate that fails cannot be resubmitted unchanged. In simulation, ℋ t \mathcal{H}_{t} consists of these harness and development runs; on the robot, it consists of the four most recent eligible runs, replayed offline (Appendix D.4 ). A compound skill is proposed once a task has at least three successful executions whose tool sequences share at least 60% of their longest common subsequence and a common skeleton of at least three steps. The generated skill replays the skeleton and recomputes every argument from perception at run time, never storing coordinates from an episode, and it passes the same review and validation as any other revision.
paragraphs.zh: 每个技能都有一个描述符，用于声明其参数、带类型的返回字段、适用性条件以及一个验证框架（模拟任务、种子、参数和任何设置技能）。 返回字段会报告预期效果是否得到验证；例如，一个放置技能会返回是否到达目标、夹具是否打开以及释放是否得到验证，并且除非其抓取和保持检查通过，否则不会打开夹具。 一个原子任务只有在最后动作之后获取的新观察结果满足其后置条件时，才被视为完成。 候选修订版本会被暂存于库的一个隔离副本中，并由管理器进行审查。 如果它修改了某个基础技能，则该技能的验证框架会在模拟器中运行；随后，完整的原子任务会再次在其开发种子上运行。 发布要求至少在两个声明的种子上模拟成功、试验结束后恢复未修改的源代码，并获得管理器的批准且没有待处理的更改；失败的候选版本不得以未修改的形式重新提交。 在模拟中，ℋ t \mathcal{H}_{t} 由这些验证框架和开发运行组成；而在机器人上，它由最近四个符合条件的运行组成，这些运行会离线重放（附录 D.4）。 当一个任务至少有三次成功执行，且这些执行的工具序列共享至少 60% 的最长公共子序列以及一个至少包含三个步骤的通用骨架时，才会提出一个复合技能。 生成的技能会重放该骨架，并在运行时根据感知信息重新计算每个参数，从不存储任何回合中的坐标，并且它会与其他任何修订版本一样通过相同的审查和验证。

sents.en: Each skill has a descriptor that declares its arguments, typed return fields, applicability conditions, and a validation harness (simulator task, seeds, arguments, and any setup skill).
sents.zh: 每个技能都有一个描述符，用于声明其参数、带类型的返回字段、适用性条件以及一个验证框架（模拟任务、种子、参数和任何设置技能）。

sents.en: The return fields report whether the intended effect was verified; for example, a placement skill returns whether the target was reached, the gripper opened, and the release was verified, and it does not open the gripper unless its reach and hold checks pass.
sents.zh: 返回字段会报告预期效果是否得到验证；例如，一个放置技能会返回是否到达目标、夹具是否打开以及释放是否得到验证，并且除非其抓取和保持检查通过，否则不会打开夹具。

sents.en: An atomic task counts as complete only when its postcondition holds on fresh observations taken after the last action.
sents.zh: 一个原子任务只有在最后动作之后获取的新观察结果满足其后置条件时，才被视为完成。

sents.en: A candidate revision is staged in an isolated copy of the library and reviewed by the Manager.
sents.zh: 候选修订版本会被暂存于库的一个隔离副本中，并由管理器进行审查。

sents.en: If it changes a base skill, the harness of that skill runs in the simulator; the complete atomic task is then re-run on its development seeds.
sents.zh: 如果它修改了某个基础技能，则该技能的验证框架会在模拟器中运行；随后，完整的原子任务会再次在其开发种子上运行。

sents.en: Release requires simulator success on at least two declared seeds, restoration of the unmodified source after the trial, and Manager approval with no outstanding changes; a candidate that fails cannot be resubmitted unchanged.

sents.en: In simulation, ℋ t \mathcal{H}_{t} consists of these harness and development runs; on the robot, it consists of the four most recent eligible runs, replayed offline (Appendix D.4 ).
sents.zh: 在模拟中，ℋ t \mathcal{H}_{t} 由这些验证框架和开发运行组成；而在机器人上，它由最近四个符合条件的运行组成，这些运行会离线重放（附录 D.4）。

sents.zh: 当一个任务至少有三次成功执行，且这些执行的工具序列共享至少 60% 的最长公共子序列以及一个至少包含三个步骤的通用骨架时，才会提出一个复合技能。

sents.en: The generated skill replays the skeleton and recomputes every argument from perception at run time, never storing coordinates from an episode, and it passes the same review and validation as any other revision.

paragraphs.en: The mobile cleanup development record spans 104 runs. Each run starts from a common docking pose. The robot is expected to place the specified objects in their designated receptacles and return to the docking pose.

paragraphs.zh: RoboRSI 可以在不同运行之间调整其技能，但每个运行内部的技能版本保持固定。 仅在必要时进行修订，而非每次运行后都进行修订。 候选修订方案在后续运行中使用前，会对照保留并审查过的执行记录进行检查；此检查不会实际重复早期任务。 因此，这 104 次运行追踪的是一个不断演化的系统在多样化任务表现中的发展过程，而非在相同任务上对固定策略的重复试验。

paragraphs.en: This appendix reports the failure classification, exploratory development, and small-scale policy learning.
paragraphs.zh: 本附录报告了故障分类、探索性开发以及小范围策略学习。

paragraphs.en: Each failed episode receives one category from deterministic rules over its public tool results and the simulator’s terminal outcome. Explicit fields such as an empty grasp, a dropped object, a rejected release, or an unreachable target determine grasp, placement/release, and motion/reachability failures; for complete traces, the last explicit failure step is used. An episode in which the agent declares success while the simulator reports failure is a premature completion, and an episode that ends at the interaction limit is budget exhausted. Episodes whose traces support none of these rules are unlabeled. Categories are counted separately for each evaluation panel; the analysis covers 5,008 failed episodes. Completion after a failure (Figure 6 c) is computed on the (task, seed) pairs for which every method has a complete trace and encounters at least one execution failure, 209 on LIBERO-PRO and 258 on LIBERO-Plus; it is the fraction of these episodes that still end in simulator success.
paragraphs.zh: 每个失败的回合都会根据确定性规则，从其公开工具结果和模拟器的最终结果中分配一个类别。 明确字段（如空抓握、掉落物体、释放被拒绝或目标无法到达）会决定抓握、放置/释放以及运动/可达性方面的失败；对于完整的轨迹，会使用最后一个明确的失败步骤。 如果智能体宣布成功而模拟器报告失败，则该回合属于提前结束；如果回合在交互限制处结束，则属于预算耗尽。 其轨迹不支持上述任何规则的回合将被标记为无标签。 每个评估面板的类别都会单独计数；分析涵盖了 5,008 个失败的回合。 失败后的完成度（图 6c）是在那些所有方法都有完整轨迹且至少遇到一次执行失败的（任务，种子）对上计算的：LIBERO-PRO 上有 209 个，LIBERO-Plus 上有 258 个；它表示这些回合中最终仍以模拟器成功结束的比例。

sents.en: Each failed episode receives one category from deterministic rules over its public tool results and the simulator’s terminal outcome.
sents.zh: 每个失败的回合都会根据确定性规则，从其公开工具结果和模拟器的最终结果中分配一个类别。

sents.en: Explicit fields such as an empty grasp, a dropped object, a rejected release, or an unreachable target determine grasp, placement/release, and motion/reachability failures; for complete traces, the last explicit failure step is used.

paragraphs.en: Demonstrations are successful RoboRSI executions on fixed collection layouts: ten for click_bell , yielding 2,161 training samples, and seven for click_alarmclock . Both action representations use the same ACT architecture, with a ResNet-18 visual backbone trained from scratch, a transformer width of 256, action chunks of 100 steps of which 25 are executed per inference, a KL weight of 1, and 10,000 training steps. The absolute version predicts joint position commands directly. The chunk-relative version predicts joint positions relative to the arm configuration at the start of each chunk, with gripper and velocity outputs unchanged. Final checkpoints run through a standalone inference server without online agent assistance, with a budget of 2,000 control ticks per episode. Evaluation covers the ten training layouts of click_bell and the ten collection layouts of click_alarmclock , seven of which supplied training demonstrations.
paragraphs.zh: 演示是在固定收集布局上成功执行的 RoboRSI：click_bell 有十种布局，产生了 2,161 个训练样本；click_alarmclock 有七种布局。 两种动作表示都使用相同的 ACT 架构，包括从头训练的 ResNet-18 视觉主干、宽度为 256 的变换器、每个推理步骤执行 25 步的动作分块（总长 100 步）、KL 权重为 1，以及 10,000 个训练步骤。 绝对版本直接预测关节位置指令。 分块相对版本预测各分块开始时相对于手臂配置的关节位置，而夹具和速度输出保持不变。 最终检查点在无需在线智能体协助的情况下通过独立推理服务器运行，每集预算为 2,000 个控制时间步。 评估涵盖了 click_bell 的十种训练布局和 click_alarmclock 的十种收集布局，其中七种提供了训练演示。

paragraphs.en: This case follows an earlier revision of guarded_compact_feature_tap on click_bell . Both candidates were reviewed by GPT-5.6-SOL Manager calls and evaluated on the same three declared initial states, invocation arguments, and independent simulator-success criterion. Each version ran once per initial state. The original candidate succeeded in one of the three trials (1/3); the revised candidate succeeded in all three (3/3), with no crashes. It met the predeclared requirement of at least two successes and was then published. These six runs form the development comparison below.

paragraphs.en: Execution. The robot held a food wrapper in front of the correct bag-lined trash bin, which remained visually distinct from a nearby light-blue bucket. The compiled observation move reported a 0.052 m and 17.1 ∘ tolerance miss, although the current joint and end-effector state and the third-person video showed the arm at the requested pose. The unrestricted fallback repeated opening estimation from the same view, invoked Arm Explore with an invalid self-inspection target, and exhausted 28 merged tool calls. A workspace probe had already stored a complete three-step release sequence in runtime memory, but the model passed an incomplete copy to place_object . Both calls failed closed before motion; the gripper never opened, and the robot returned to its docked home pose with the item still held. Diagnosis. The earliest failing node was completion of the placement observation motion. Its false negative expanded into duplicated geometry estimation and an incomplete release plan. Revision. (i) A failed observation move receives one read-only pose recheck, and a physically reached pose continues without replaying the placement chain. (ii) An unreached pose returns a non-releasable checkpoint to the Planner, with Engineer fallback disabled. (iii) Probing and release above a container require opening geometry from the current observation rather than semantic rim identity alone. (iv) place_object replaces an incomplete model-written sequence with the complete sequence held in runtime destination memory. Validation. Five new regression tests, 172 placement tests, 863 manager tests, and 97 real-robot interface tests passed. The next run required a fresh human reset of the scene.

paragraphs.en: Execution. A single sweep over five headings recorded all eight expected scene entities. The first item was released and its detachment confirmed, but the run ended after about 25 minutes with the second item still held. Two owners failed. The inventory producer chose an isolated but edge-cropped view of the destination bucket although the same sweep contained a complete view, and the consumer then treated the blue color ratio as a mandatory check and rejected the producer-certified destination. Earlier, a navigation to the item had been attempted but not completed and produced no post-navigation image; this state was routed to Engineer fallback, which repeated status, power, and camera queries and exhausted the merged budget before a single compiled retry succeeded. Revision. Inventory selection prefers complete, non-edge observations; query color becomes advisory during materialization because the producer owns semantic identity, while current-frame navigation and manipulation checks remain in force; and incomplete navigation without a post-navigation image returns a typed checkpoint to the Planner instead of entering fallback. The revision adds no new object or destination branch, no episode coordinates, no historical pose gate, and no change to global color thresholds. Validation. An offline replay of the trigger run selected the complete bucket view, materialized the destination, and routed the incomplete navigation to the Planner. The replay buffer contained four consecutive blocked runs with different terminal failures: a true destination rejected by a score veto, a defensive post-release check, exhausted placement regions, and the color veto above. Twenty-eight focused tests, 866 manager tests, and 97 real-robot interface tests passed. Resets before and after the run were planned; no unplanned human prompt occurred during execution.

paragraphs.en: Four of the 53 classified revision triggers in the physical development (Section 4.1 ) required knowledge that the system could not obtain from its own records (Figure 14 ). In Round 23, a released item landed outside the intended container. The operator specified that a confirmed misplacement contaminates the scene and must be reset by a person, rather than being treated as a new source object for the robot to recover. In Round 31, the grasp approach had to respect a default linear speed of 0.02 m/s that the validated motion sequence did not yet consume; the operator supplied and confirmed this safety limit. In Round 37, a wrapper fell beside the bin after release, and the operator judged the placement a failure that required a scene reset, not a success or a step for automatic recovery. In Round 99, the robot still held an item when the task stopped, and the item was later lost while the robot waited at its dock. The operator specified that holding protection must inherit the reviewed grip width and force and, when the hold is lost, freeze motion and request confirmation instead of moving or releasing. Each correction is kept as a reusable contract, checkpoint, or test on the responsible skill, so the same prompt is not needed again.

sents.zh: 操作员指定，经确认的放置错误会污染场景，必须由人工重置，而不能被机器人视为新的源对象进行回收。

sents.en: In Round 31, the grasp approach had to respect a default linear speed of 0.02 m/s that the validated motion sequence did not yet consume; the operator supplied and confirmed this safety limit.
sents.zh: 在第 31 轮中，抓取方式必须遵守默认线性速度 0.02 m/s，而验证后的运动序列尚未消耗该速度；操作员提供了这一安全限制并进行了确认。

sents.en: In Round 37, a wrapper fell beside the bin after release, and the operator judged the placement a failure that required a scene reset, not a success or a step for automatic recovery.
sents.zh: 在第 37 轮中，一个包装物在释放后掉落在箱子旁边，操作员判断该放置为失败，需要重置场景，而非视为成功或自动恢复的步骤。

sents.en: In Round 99, the robot still held an item when the task stopped, and the item was later lost while the robot waited at its dock.
sents.zh: 在第 99 轮中，任务停止时机器人仍握持着一个物品，之后该物品在机器人于其停靠点等待时丢失了。

sents.en: The operator specified that holding protection must inherit the reviewed grip width and force and, when the hold is lost, freeze motion and request confirmation instead of moving or releasing.
sents.zh: 操作员指定，握持保护必须继承经过审查的抓握宽度和力度，并在握持丢失时冻结运动并请求确认，而不是移动或释放。

sents.en: Each correction is kept as a reusable contract, checkpoint, or test on the responsible skill, so the same prompt is not needed again.
sents.zh: 每次修正都会被保留为可重用的合同、检查点或对负责技能的测试，因此无需再次使用相同的提示。
